scope: Bounded native storage and persisted-action preflight; exact indexed source tree, excluding concurrent assignment UI work
coverage: Bounded growing-stream reads, BOM and opaque-field preservation
Original and temporary file preservation on deterministic refusal
Byte and structural-token refusals before protocol SET
Device aliases and normalized DPI/stage persistence
Recovery backup failure and partial hardware failure
Separate conservative byte/token bounds for partial multi-device sync
limitations: A filesystem failure after a successful device write remains possible; no hardware rollback is claimed
Conservative partial-sync bounds may refuse a near-limit result that would fit
No interprocess locking or general power-loss guarantee
